$comment: ZoFHub — sing-box configuration TEMPLATE.
sing-box (github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) is GPL-3.0 and is a SEPARATE daemon
that you run yourself. ZoFHub does not bundle, build, start or derive from
it, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by its authors. This file is a
starting template written against sing-box's published config format.
VALIDATE BEFORE USE — the schema changes between major versions:
sing-box check -c config.json
Every ${PLACEHOLDER} must be replaced. Generate the REALITY keypair with:
sing-box generate reality-keypair
sing-box generate uuid
Keep the private key and the API secret in the environment, never in git.
Full setup and the admin-panel integration: docs/proxy/SINGBOX.md
The Clash-compatible management API. This is the ONE surface ZoFHub's
admin panel reads (lib/singbox.mjs → GET /api/admin/proxy).
BIND IT TO LOOPBACK. Anyone who reaches this API can rewrite routing and
enumerate every live connection. It must never face the public internet;
ZoFHub reads it server-side precisely so no browser ever touches it.
VLESS + REALITY. REALITY borrows the TLS handshake of a real external
site (handshake.server) instead of presenting its own certificate, so
it needs to OWN port 443 — which is why this cannot run inside ZoFHub's
existing single-container deploy, where the platform edge owns TLS.
server_name MUST match handshake.server, and that host must be a real,
reachable TLS site that is not already associated with this deployment.

users.$comment: One entry per client. The uuid IS the credential — cycling a client means replacing this value and hot-reloading.
users.name: owner

outbounds.$comment: No `block` outbound: sing-box removed that type after 1.11, and a config declaring it fails `sing-box check`. Rejecting is a route ACTION now — see route.rules below.

$comment: Rules match in order; `final` is the fallback.
The private/loopback reject is load-bearing, not decorative: without it a
tunnelled client can reach 127.0.0.1 on the proxy host, which includes the
clash_api controller above — letting any client rewrite routing and read
every other connection. 169.254.169.254 is the cloud instance-metadata
endpoint that hands out credentials, and the RFC1918 ranges are whatever
else shares the host's private network.
THIS LIST IS DELIBERATELY IDENTICAL to config.template.json's. Two
profiles that block different things is how the less-used one quietly
becomes the way in; a test asserts they stay in step.
`action: reject` replaces the `block` outbound type removed after 1.11.
